# Machine SM — thin stub over the FROZEN machine loop
# (IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows, reusable).
#
# Same freeze contract as dmtools-dart's machine-sm.yml: the workflow is
# pinned to an immutable SHA; agent code and the dmtools CLI resolve from
# RELEASES at run time via this repo's variables:
#   vars.AGENTS_VERSION  — dmtools-agents release tag ('latest' default)
#   vars.DMTOOLS_VERSION — dmtools-dart CLI release tag ('latest' default)
# Bump a version = repo-settings edit, never a workflow edit.
# NO caller-side concurrency: the factory owns the `machine-sm` group.

name: 'Machine SM'

run-name: >-
  🧹 SM ${{
    github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'manual tick' ||
    format('tick {0}', github.event.schedule || '') }}${{
  github.event.inputs.dryRun == 'true' && ' (dry)' || '' }}

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/10 * * * *'   # short ticks — the engine idles when busy
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dryRun:
        description: 'Log the plan, perform no action'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: write         # checkout + silent update-branch pushes
  issues: write           # labels + close-issue safety net
  pull-requests: write    # update-branch + merge
  checks: write           # bridge-free validation stamps
  actions: write          # workflow_dispatch on the teammate workflow

jobs:
  sm:
    # Pinned to the immutable SHA of IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows main
    # (the frozen machine-loop home; bump the SHA only together with the
    # matching loop change).
    uses: IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/factory-sm.yml@main
    with:
      # No .dmtools/config.js in this repo — the machine logins ride the
      # deployment-level input (#687, gh-728), exactly like the factory's
      # contract. Comma-separated LIST: the agent harness bot AND the CI
      # bot — github-actions[bot] authors its own PRs (live fa PR #1249)
      # and must ride the machine path (owner directive 2026-10-05).
      machine-author: 'ai-teammate,github-actions[bot],dmtools-factory-bot'
      # This repo dispatches no CI on PR heads (docs checks only) — the SM
      # leaves validation to the event-driven merge bot and labels.
      ci-workflow: ''
      # Manual ticks default to dry; cron ticks run live.
      dryRun: ${{ github.event.inputs.dryRun || 'false' }}
      # Factory-state snapshot → factory-data branch (board: site/factory,
      # third tab; fa machine-sm.yml parity — transport lives in
      # js/factoryState.js, publishing is opt-in per factory).
      state-publish: '{"channel":"release","tag":"factory-data","asset":"agents-state.json"}'
      # Silent branch updates: input channel (github.token via secrets/in
      # blocks arrives empty through a reusable call — live-verified).
      silent-token: ${{ github.token }}
    secrets:
      SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # App auth (awf#52): minted installation token wins over the PAT
      # inside the factory when both secrets are present.
      APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
      APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      SILENT_GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SILENT_GH_TOKEN }}

content.text:
Round-2 re-review complete — all outputs verified.

## Re-review verdict: `REQUEST_CHANGES` (2 BLOCKING, 2 IMPORTANT, 1 SUGGESTION)

**Round-1 verification — all 6 threads genuinely fixed.** The rework lap is high quality: `checkout_ref` declared in the template with a CI-failing indentation-parsing lint (14/14 tests), the gh-1028 gate gained a well-reasoned pull-keyed probe with 8 pure boundary tests plus 2 tick-level regression tests (the literal `checkoutRef || branch` keying was correctly rejected — dispatch runs record `head_branch = main`, so the run-title `· pr-<N>` anchor is the right discriminator), the probe has a distinct DEGRADED warning, the `headRepo:null` contract is pinned by a dedicated test, and the fork park wording is fixed with REG-1 byte-parity asserted. Suites re-verified locally on head `a2013520`: **14/14 forkDispatch, 24/24 branchLegGuard, 628/628 smAgent**.

**The two blockers:**

1. 🚨 **CI `crap` gate fails this head** (run 39218810451, log fetched): `NEW > 8` — `titleHasPrToken: 16`, `legRunOwnsPull: 8.1`, `declaredDispatchInputs: 10`; "0 regression(s), 3 new over threshold". All introduced by this PR; merge is mechanically blocked until they're under the threshold.

2. 🚨 **`git ls-remote origin` probes the wrong repository.** The rework applied my round-1 "probe origin" suggestion, but that idiom belongs to legs (which run inside a target checkout). The codebase documents the SM runtime itself: *"The reconcile job's working directory is the dmtools-agents engine checkout … the builder clones the TARGET repo instead"* (`js/smAgent.js:2049-2051`). So on every SM whose target repo ≠ engine repo, the probe asks the engine repo: a live fork PR misclassifies as `'dead'` and gets **wrongly parked with markers** — AC2 inverted with real damage. Fix: authenticated probe of `repoInfo.owner/repoInfo.repo` via the `forkPushTokenUrl` split-literal `${GH_TOKEN}` idiom (the `repoInfo` parameter is now dead — it should be used again).

**Important:** the new `pr-<N>` title-anchor gate is blind on the self-host stub — `.github/workflows/ai-teammate.yml:32` run-name echoes `inputs.issue`, never `pr`, so on the live-incident repo itself the gate matches nothing and silently degrades; and `checkout_ref` is declared but consumed nowhere, so fork legs would silently review the `main` tree — please confirm the consumption is actually tracked (the #1074 observability lane doesn't obviously own checkout behavior). **Suggestion:** dedupe the fork/branch park-body ternary.
